description: AI AUTO-REPLIES: the brand's AI answers people who write to it, in its voice, from its brand profile, Memory, product catalog and the FAQs and notes saved here. Covers Instagram (DMs, story replies, comments), Facebook (Messenger, Page and ad comments), WhatsApp, and comments on TikTok, Threads, YouTube and LinkedIn Pages (not X: X requires its own approval for AI replies). Keyword automations (save_dm_automation) always answer first. OFF by default; switching on starts in mode "test" (every answer is written and logged, nothing sent) until mode "live". Pass nothing to read the settings and today's counts. Only the fields passed change. A message goes to a person instead (handoff) on a handoff keyword, an intent in handoff.intents (default complaint, refund), confidence below handoff.minConfidence, or a neverAnswer topic. Each AI reply is charged at the model's real cost (standard about 1 credit, best about 4); saving is free. Email: email.autoSend is the same opt-in for email replies (set_email_reply_settings autoSend).

accounts.description: only these accounts, as "instagram:<id>" (list_connector_accounts); [] = every connected account on the channels switched on

channels.description: per channel (instagram, facebook, whatsapp, tiktok, threads, youtube, linkedin): true/false, or {dm, comment}; e.g. {"instagram": {"dm": true, "comment": true}, "whatsapp": true}

commentReply.description: Instagram/Facebook comments: a public reply under it (default), or Meta's one private message

dailyCap.description: most AI replies sent per day across all channels (default 200)

discloseAi.description: default true: the first DM to a person says it is the brand's automated assistant (Messenger policy)

enabled.description: true switches AI replies on for this brand, false off

keywords.description: words that always go to a person, e.g. ["human", "agent", "refund"]

message.description: sent to the person on a DM handoff, e.g. "Thanks! Someone from our team will reply shortly."

mode.description: answer always, only within the hours, or only outside them

notes.description: anything else it should know: policies, shipping, hours, links

mode.description: test = written and logged, nothing sent (the default); live = sent

neverAnswer.description: topics it never answers (they go to a person), e.g. ["medical advice", "legal"]

quality.description: standard = fast model (about 1 credit a reply), best = strongest (about 4)

resume.description: true clears a pause (after a top-up or a reconnect)

tone.description: how the replies sound, e.g. "warm, short, a little playful; never pushy"

name: set_ai_replies
title: AI auto-replies: settings
